not_loaded: Spool Inventory is not set up. Add it under Settings > Devices & services.
not_a_spool: This action only works on spool sensors, not on the summary sensors.
weight_conflict: Provide either remaining_weight or gross_weight, not both.
gross_below_tare: The weighed value ({gross} g) is lower than the empty spool weight ({tare} g). Check the empty spool weight.
catalog_full: Your own catalog is full (500 entries). Remove some entries first.
import_invalid: That file is not a Spool Inventory backup.
not_in_trash: That spool is no longer in the recently deleted list.
task_not_found: That maintenance task does not exist.
item_not_found: That part or consumable does not exist.
task_invalid: The maintenance task needs a name, an interval of 1 to 3650 days and a date that is not in the future.
item_invalid: The part or consumable needs a name and valid numbers.
equipment_full: The limit of printers, tasks or items is reached.
